slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does each product have to be processed in the fixed sequence Machine 1 → Machine 2 → Machine 3 (i.e., a product cannot start on Machine 2 until it has finished on Machine 1, and cannot start on Machine 3 until it has finished on Machine 2)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each product follows the fixed machine sequence 1→2→3, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total time (makespan) until all three products have finished on all three machines?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize makespan, clarifying the meaning of total processing cycle.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; remaining questions concerned minor modeling details.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots—the fixed machine sequence and the makespan objective—before stopping, and also clarified permutation ordering and timing assumptions. The interaction quality was strong with no material unresolved issues.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
